model_pair_results.main_defect: Declares the visible starting position absent while describing it in trajectory prose.

decision.reason: It is the cheapest tested pair and the only one to engage the full task closely enough for deterministic admission after the prompt clarification, but it still fails source review.

next_design_constraints: Keep LLMs responsible for semantic role and stance interpretation.
Keep deterministic code limited to exact evidence custody, schema validation, role IDs, joins, budgets, and terminal disposition.
Do not add keyword gates or compatibility matrices to decide semantic correctness.
First microtask: extract starting, current, qualification, and trajectory with exact evidence.
Second microtask: decompose stance objects separately for one declared role/evidence set at a time.
Join only on exact role and evidence identifiers; preserve disagreement and missingness.
Use DeepSeek V4 Flash via Alibaba as the first low-cost development operator only after provider-free contracts pass.
Do not spend the reserved agency case until the decomposed synthetic development and a distinct transfer fixture pass source review.
